answer: Agents earn work through an onyx meadow bond. Each agent locks a refundable bond tied to a non-transferable work record. It first completes small verified tasks in low-risk work, building a record that opens larger jobs only as it grows. A failed spot check slashes part of the bond and wipes the record, forcing a fresh start, and a violet flag warns other agents. A fake cannot multiply, since each copy needs its own bond and slow history. A fake costs, assumed here, $2,300, or about $2,300,000 for 1,000 fakes, like planting a meadow that must regrow after every fire.
